name: SCW World Heavyweight Championship
notes: Named in the promotion's own info packets of June to September 2001 as the SCW World Heavyweight Champion's title.
epitaph: The promotion's top title. Maverick held it longer than anyone before him, until his partner Viper won it from him with a lead-pipe betrayal behind it in June 2001; by November it had passed to Mike Powers, with Van Hammer next in line at Holiday Havok.

name: SCW World Television Championship
notes: Named SCW World Television Champion in the promotion's own info packets; called the Television Title on its broadcasts.
epitaph: A secondary title first held, in the Superior Wrestling Alliance days, by the Freek. Iron Man Jordan Jones carried it for some six months into mid-2001; it passed through Charles Purnell and Kevin Candido before Kyren Knight held it that November, defended, in the commentators' words, twice a week.

name: SCW North American Championship
notes: Named in the promotion's own info packets of June to September 2001.
epitaph: Held by Heavy Metal Van Hammer through the summer and autumn of 2001, a reign his challenger put at seven months, and by Eric Draven by the end of November.
